id: 1203-合蘭真沙陀-折折運都山之戰
theater: 合蘭真沙陀、折折運都山（漠南）

battle.name: 合蘭真沙陀-折折運都山之戰
battle.theater: 合蘭真沙陀、折折運都山（漠南）
battle.brief: 1203年春，大汗命木華黎經略金地，兵鋒抵金界壕以北的漠南，在合蘭真沙陀與折折運都山與金軍邊騎接戰。蒙古以哨騎迂迴包抄取勝，不攻城而壓迫金軍糧道；金廷以簽軍、屯田、界壕設防，戰事延入冬季。卡面希臘火並未到場，同年十字軍圍城君士坦丁堡，拜占庭守軍正把燃燒兵器架上狄奧多西城牆。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 這場戰鬥是大蒙古國在1203年春天對金朝北方邊境發動的第一次大規模攻勢，雙方都是帝國級的組織。蒙古一方由大汗下令，以木華黎為經略金地的統帥，兵權按十人十夫、百人百夫、千人千夫、萬戶四級編制分派，萬戶長之下另有千戶長、百戶長與十夫長，各自率領本部騎兵作戰；行軍不帶攻城大軍，只帶一日到數日的輕裝口糧，離營須由本部長率領，不得擅自散失。隊伍除蒙古本部兵外，還有早先歸附的契丹、漢人武裝，以及隨軍的鐵匠、木匠與攻城匠人，木華黎的打法是典型的草原式：哨騎探明金軍縱深，別部示弱誘敵，大隊由側後迂迴，不與金軍爭奪城池。金方是宣宗完顏珣治下的金朝，北方防務由西京路、河東、河北西路三處邊軍分擔，防線上除了中樞調來的禁軍與各路統軍司、招討司的兵馬，還有按戶口簽發的軍戶、按保甲與招募編成的義軍，以及屯田並驅馬給軍的邊地屯戍。金廷的指揮系統以尚書省樞密院居中統籌，分遣統軍使、招討使、屯田使各領一路，地方上則由州縣官兼理城守與徵發。1203年時兩邊仍維持脆弱的邊界貿易，金廷關閉榷場、增築界壕，蒙古則以牧場被侵、叛逃部眾未歸為由反覆挑釁。這一戰之後兩邊的軍制都加速改變：蒙古以漢地軍伍補足攻城與守城的力量，金廷則把北方漢地州縣的軍政權力收歸樞密院直轄。
countriesEn: The fighting was part of the first large offensive the Mongol Empire launched against the northern frontier of the Jin dynasty in the spring of 1203, and both sides were organised at the scale of empires. On the Mongol side the order came from the Great Khan, with Muqali appointed to carry out the conquest of Jin territory. Command was divided into the four-step ladder of ten-man, hundred-man, thousand-man and ten-thousand units, each led by its own officer, and the men fought as mounted households under their own banners. The columns travelled without heavy siege trains, carrying only a few days of provisions, and no one was allowed to leave the ranks or stray from his unit. Beside the Mongol tribal levies the army absorbed Khitan and Chinese contingents that had submitted earlier, together with the smiths, carpenters and siege craftsmen needed for engineering work. Muqali's method was the classic steppe one: scouts mapped the depth of the Jin formations, detached columns showed weakness and drew the enemy forward, and the main body closed from the flank and the rear rather than fighting for towns. The Jin side was the state of Jin Xuanzong Wanyan Xun. Its northern defence was divided among the frontier garrisons of Xijing Circuit, Hedong and the western part of Hebei. The line held not only troops of the central army and of the various military commissions and recruiting offices, but also households levied for service, volunteer units raised by local militia and recruitment, and agricultural colonies that supplied grain and horses. At the centre the Board of War coordinated everything, while circuit commanders, recruiting commissioners and commanders of agricultural colonies ran the separate fronts, with prefects and county magistrates doubling as garrison commanders and as the men responsible for raising men and grain. In 1203 the two states still maintained a fragile border trade: the Jin court had closed the frontier markets and reinforced the boundary ditches, and the Mongols kept provoking incidents over raided pastureland and tribesmen who had fled into Jin territory. After this campaign both war machines changed: the Mongols absorbed Han Chinese formations to make up for their shortage of siege and garrison troops, and the Jin court pulled the military government of the northern Chinese provinces directly under the central bureau.
people: 蒙古方面的關鍵人物是木華黎。他是大汗的異母弟，也是草原上最能打的名將，1203年奉命經略金地時已近六十歲，卻把這場戰爭做成一次長期的、靠速度取勝的邊疆戰役，而不是一次決戰。他最信任的副手是博兒忽，掌管哨騎與別部的分遣，兩人在漠南的牧營與金國前線之間往返調度。蒙古的其他王公仍在漠北或別條戰線上，這次攻金並非諸王聯合出征，而是交給木華黎單獨受命、逐步擴張的持久戰。金方的主政者是宣宗完顏珣，他1189年即位，面對的是一個已被北方草原壓力逼到盡頭的政權：既不肯放棄邊地，又不敢全面開戰，朝廷裡長期有「用兵」與「結好」兩種聲音。真正在邊境承擔壓力的是各路統軍使、招討使與巡邊將校，完顏承裕便是其中之一，這位金廷名將在往後的野狐嶺與汴京之圍中都居統兵之位；金廷同時起用漢地將領與猛安謀克混編的隊伍，讓熟悉城池與地形的人去守邊。戰役的另一端，地中海東岸有另一場攻城同期進行：自1203年起，第四次十字軍圍攻君士坦丁堡，拜占庭皇帝阿列克修斯三世與威尼斯總督恩里科·丹多洛隔牆對峙，而卡面那件希臘火正架在狄奧多西城牆與金角灣的船上，由守軍操作銅管把燃燒劑噴向拉丁人的攻城塔與戰船。
peopleEn: Through the Mongol side the decisive figure was Muqali, the half-brother of the Great Khan and the finest campaigner on the steppe. When he was ordered to take charge of Jin territory in 1203 he was close to sixty, yet he turned the campaign into a long war of speed along the frontier rather than one set-piece battle. His most trusted lieutenant was Bo'orchu, who handled the scouts and the dispatch of detached columns, and the two men rode between the steppe camps and the Jin front shifting the army from one objective to the next. The other Mongol princes remained with the Great Khan or on other fronts; the campaign of 1203 was therefore not a combined expedition of all the princes but a long war entrusted to Muqali alone, whose reach was extended step by step. On the Jin side the government was in the hands of Xuanzong Wanyan Xun, who had come to the throne in 1189 and faced a state already pushed to its limit by pressure from the northern steppe: he would not abandon the border lands, yet he dared not fight a general war, and the court permanently split between the party that wanted to fight and the party that wanted to make terms. The men who actually bore the pressure on the frontier were the circuit commanders, the recruiting commissioners and the commanders of the border patrols; among them was Wanyan Chengyu, one of the dynasty's leading generals, who later held command at Yehuling and at the siege of Bianjing. The Jin also mixed Jurchen and Han Chinese formations, putting men who knew the towns and the ground in charge of the defences. At the other end of Eurasia a second siege was running in the same years: from 1203 the Fourth Crusade besieged Constantinople, where the Byzantine emperor Alexios III Angelos and the doge of Venice, Enrico Dandolo, faced each other across the walls. The weapon on this card, Greek fire, stood on the Theodosian walls and on the ships in the Golden Horn, and Byzantine crews worked the bronze siphons that doused the Latin siege towers and set ablaze the Venetian vessels.
kits: 卡面那件兵器是希臘火：拜占庭帝國守了數百年的秘密配方，灌在銅管裡，由人操管把點燃的燃燒劑噴出去，專門用來燒毀船隻、攻城塔與城下的器械，配方不外傳，連載著它的船也一起沉掉不讓人拆。1203年的這場邊境戰鬥裡沒有希臘火，金國的北方防線上不可能出現拜占庭的銅管，但同一族技術在這片戰區並非全然陌生：中國自十一世紀起就有「猛火油」，《武經總要》記著用猛火油櫃灌火，靠抛石機或人力潑灑，燒毀攻城梯與帆布帳；到十三世紀，金廷更造出突火槍與震天雷，1212年滁州之戰中守軍用震天雷與突火槍對付蒙古軍，這種以火與燃燒劑為核心的兵器同樣被嚴格保密。蒙古軍自身的裝備是另一套：蒙古弓配骨鏃與鐵鏃的箭，標槍，蒙古刀，骨朵，皮甲、氈甲與少量鎖子甲，馬匹護具，帳車與駝隊帶著帳幕、口糧與箭壺；攻城時用配重式抛石機、雲梯、穿穴槌與帷幕覆蓋的攻城塔，並以濕牛皮、壕溝與土牆對付火攻，對付守軍的抛石機則靠散開駐地。金軍裝備以弓弩為主，神臂弓與蹶張弩部署在城頭與陣前，城防用拒馬、陷馬坑、柴草垛與濕泥，另有石砲與火油對付蒙古的攻城器械；糧秣靠屯田與沿邊收購供應，金軍的戰鬥距離普遍短於蒙古騎兵，因此多依賴城垣與壕溝換取時間。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire: a burning charge kept secret by the Byzantine state, poured into bronze tubes and driven out by men working the tubes so that it doused ships, siege towers and the machines below the walls; the formula never left the empire, and even the ships were sunk rather than let anyone take them apart. No Greek fire stood in this frontier war of 1203: bronze siphons from Byzantium could not appear on the northern defensive line of the Jin. Yet a related family of techniques was not entirely unknown in the same theatre. China had burning oil from the eleventh century, and the Wujing Zongyao records oil carts used to douse fire, thrown by stone engines or carried by hand, to burn ladders and canvas sheds; by the thirteenth century the Jin court had produced the fire lance and the thunder-crash bomb, and at the fighting at Chuzhou in 1212 the defenders used them against Mongol troops. Such weapons, centred on fire and burning charge, were guarded as state secrets in the same way. The Mongols' own equipment was a different set altogether: the Mongol bow with bone and iron arrowheads, javelins, the Mongol sabre, the mace, leather and felt armour with a little mail, horse gear, and tent-wagons and camel trains carrying tents, rations and quivers. For sieges they brought counterweight stone engines, ladders, picks for tunnelling and canvas-covered assault towers, and they answered fire attacks with wet hides, ditches and earthen walls; against the defenders' stone engines they dispersed and camped irregularly. The Jin fought mainly with bows and crossbows, powerful tension bows and siege crossbows on the walls and in front of the formations, and their defences used caltrops, horse pits, brushwood stacks and wet clay, with stone engines and oil against the Mongol machines. Grain came from agricultural garrisons and from state purchase along the frontier, and since Jin formations fought at shorter range than Mongol horsemen, they generally traded time for movement by holding walls and ditches.
tactics: 蒙古的打法是草原式的流動戰。合蘭真沙陀與折折運都山都在金界壕以北的草場與山隘之間，蒙古軍前哨先以數十騎散開探路，主力不紮營結寨，靠隨軍的馬群與牛羊供應肉食與奶食，夜間以氈帳環列宿營，白日行軍。接戰時，木華黎常以一支部隊前出示弱，佯作不支敗走，誘金軍騎兵離開本隊追擊，再由主力從側面與背後合圍，這是他在野狐嶺之前多次邊境戰中反覆使用的迂迴方式；若金軍據城不動，蒙古軍便不攻城，改而取糧草與牲畜，逼金廷自己調兵。金軍這邊是守城與野戰配合：巡邊騎兵在界壕沿線與蒙古哨騎互相試探，遇到大隊便退入城堡與寨柵，以城頭弓箭與石砲消耗蒙古的攻勢，蒙古的攻城塔與抛石機往往還沒推進就被火油與落石摧毀，守軍同時要防備蒙軍掘地道與填壕。金廷最大的弱點在兵源：簽軍與義軍的徵集與訓練需時，而蒙古騎兵可以在幾日內由一個戰區移到另一個戰區，這使金廷總是慢一步。
tacticsEn: The Mongols fought in the fluid style of the steppe. Both Halan Zhensha Tuo and Zhezhe Yundushan lay among the pastures and passes north of the Jin boundary ditch. The outriders of the Mongol army first scattered in dozens to scout, the main body never entrenched or fenced a camp, and meat, milk and hides came from the herds and cattle that marched with the column; at night the tents were pitched in a ring and in the day the army marched. When contact was made, Muqali habitually sent a column forward to show weakness and pretend to break, drawing the Jin cavalry out of its formation and into a pursuit, and then closed the main body in from the flank and the rear; this was the turning movement he repeated in his frontier wars before Yehuling. When the Jin sat tight in its towns the Mongols did not besiege them, but turned instead to taking grain and livestock, forcing the Jin court itself to move troops. The Jin combined garrison work with field action: patrolling cavalry along the boundary ditch tested the Mongol scouts against each other, and when they met a large force they withdrew behind walls and stockades, spending the Mongol assault with arrows and stone engines from the walls, while the Mongol assault towers and stone engines were often destroyed before they came within reach, by burning oil and by falling stones; the defenders also had to watch for tunnels and filled-in ditches. The Jin's gravest weakness was manning: raising and training levied households and volunteers took time, while Mongol horse could cross from one theatre to another in a few days, so the Jin court was always a step behind.
data: 這一戰沒有留下可以核對的精確數字，只能把能確定的部分說清楚。蒙古方面的兵力，蒙古時代的史籍慣以整數寫成大軍十萬，這類數目多半把未出帳的預備與別部一併算入，實際抵達前線的騎兵當在數萬之數；金朝方面的常備禁軍加各路簽軍，紙面總數以數十萬計，但可以確定的是，1203年能調到北方前線的主要是西京路、河東與河北西路的邊軍與屯戍，並非金廷的全部兵力。時間上，蒙古自春末推進到冬季，牧群不能越冬，冬季作戰只能靠事先存糧或就地取給，這是蒙古在華北年年重複的補給難題。距離上，蒙古前哨與本隊之間常拉開數百里的空檔，靠接力傳令的騎兵保持聯繫；兩處地名之間的間隔，以騎兵每日數十里至百里的行程推算，應在一日到數日騎程之間，這只是依行程速度所作的推算，不是史書的里程記載。攻城戰的時間尺度以「月」計：蒙古通常圍城數十日至數月不等，而金廷的援軍多在兩個月內到達，蒙古因此常在援軍到前撤圍。傷亡方面，兩書記載互相矛盾，一方常寫「斬獲若干萬」，另一方只寫「潰走」，這些整數不宜當作實數；能確定的只有兩件事：蒙古在這兩處得手，卻在往後的攻城戰中付出重得多的代價，而金的邊軍精銳亦在此後數年內大量耗於北方戰線。
dataEn: No exact figures survive for this engagement, and only what can be established may be stated. On the Mongol side the Yuan-style histories habitually write the army down in round numbers such as ten myriads of men; such totals normally include reserves and detached contingents that never reached the front, and the horsemen actually on the line were in the tens of thousands at most. On the Jin side the central army together with the levies of the circuits was recorded on paper in the hundreds of thousands, but what is certain is that what could be moved to the northern front in 1203 was chiefly the frontier garrisons and agricultural colonies of Xijing Circuit, Hedong and western Hebei, not the court's total strength. In time, the Mongol advance ran from late spring into winter; herds cannot overwinter on campaign, so winter fighting depended on grain stored in advance or taken on the spot, the perennial supply problem of the Mongols in northern China. In distance, Mongol scouts were often several hundred li ahead of the main body, kept in touch by relay riders, and the gap between the two named places, computed from a mounted column's daily march of tens to a hundred li, must have been between one and several days' ride; that is an estimate from marching speed, not a recorded mileage. Sieges were measured in months: the Mongols usually invested a town for tens of days and sometimes months, while Jin reinforcements arrived within two months, which is why the besiegers often withdrew before the relieving force came. Casualty figures in the two sets of histories contradict each other, one side writing of so many tens of thousands cut down and the other only of a routed army; such round numbers should not be taken as real. Two things are certain: the Mongols had their way at both places, yet paid far more in the sieges that followed, and the elite of the Jin frontier army was steadily worn down on the northern line in the years that followed.
cause: 要理解1203年的開戰，得回到蒙古與金朝之間那條又長又脆的邊界。金朝自世宗、章宗以來在陰山與燕山以北修築界壕，沿線設巡邊軍與屯戍，企圖用一道人工溝牆把草原與農耕隔開；蒙古則要求金開放榷場、准許牧地易貨，並追索早年叛入金境的部眾與驅口。金廷起初以「不與沙漠羈縻」為由拖延，關閉榷場、加增戍兵，邊境的小股衝突年年不絕，雙方的馬匹與物資往來在1200年前後幾乎中斷。到了1203年，大汗下令木華黎經略金地，名義上仍寫著討還叛人與打通互市，實際上是要把草原政權的兵鋒壓到金朝的心臟地帶。金廷的內部則有兩難：開戰需要兵員、糧草與沿線的堡壘，而朝廷在十年間把大量財力用於界壕與京師防務，一旦大軍壓境，徵發與調度的速度遠跟不上蒙古騎兵的移動速度；木華黎正是看穿了這一點，才把這場戰爭定成流動的、靠襲擾與破邊取勝的持久戰。
causeEn: To understand how the war of 1203 began, one has to go back to the long and brittle frontier between the Mongols and the Jin. Since the reigns of the Jin emperors Shizong and Zhangzong the dynasty had raised boundary ditches along the Yinshan and the Yan Mountains and posted patrol troops and agricultural colonies along them, trying to hold a man-made wall between steppe and farmland. The Mongols, for their part, demanded that the Jin open the frontier markets, allow the herds to trade, and hand back the tribesmen and retainers who had fled into Jin territory in earlier years. The court at first prevaricated, invoking the principle of not tying itself to the desert, closed the markets and added more garrisons, and small clashes along the line never ceased; the exchange of horses and goods between the two states had almost stopped by around 1200. In 1203 the Great Khan ordered Muqali to take Jin territory, nominally to recover the runaways and open the trade, and in substance to press the swords of a steppe power against the heart of a farming empire. The Jin faced a dilemma: war demanded men, grain and stockades along the line, while the court had spent a decade pouring money into the boundary ditches and the defence of the capital; once a real army came, the speed of raising and moving troops could not keep pace with the movement of Mongol horse. Muqali saw exactly that, and for that reason made this a mobile war won by raiding and by breaking the frontier, rather than a single decisive battle.
impact: 1203年的這一戰本身沒有決定任何王朝的存亡，它的重量在往後的十一年才完全顯現。蒙古第一次以正規兵團、以可持續的補給方式在漢地邊境連續作戰，摸清了金的城池防禦、城門構造、糧道與援軍節奏，從此攻金不再是越境劫掠，而是有計劃的長期征服；1211年野狐嶺的大敗、1214年中都陷落、1215年汴京失守，一直到1234年蔡州滅金，走的正是這條路。木華黎也在這一輪攻勢中把蒙古的統治從草原帶進中原：他先後取得漢地官署與賦稅，把簽軍改編進蒙古的編制，漢地軍隊在往後攻宋、攻西夏的戰役中成為蒙古最常用的攻城兵力，金朝留下的城防技術、器械工匠與屯田制度亦被蒙古吸收，反過來變成蒙古自己的攻城能力。金朝這邊，北方的州縣、邊軍與屯田在一次次戰役中被消耗，宣宗朝已無力同時對付蒙古與西夏，1211年後被迫把都城東遷，國策從「守邊」轉為「保中都」再轉為「保汴京」，財政與兵源在十二年內枯竭。戰役同時把一種「國家機密」的火器帶進東亞的軍備競爭：拜占庭的希臘火在1203年的君士坦丁堡之圍中仍由城牆上的銅管噴射，拉丁人的攻城塔被燒毀，威尼斯人試圖以火船反擊也在金角灣被火焚；在同一年代，金廷的突火槍與震天雷也在華北的城頭上試射，蒙古的攻城隊伍則從此固定配備覆土、濕氈與壕溝，用來對付火攻。
impactEn: The campaign of 1203 decided no dynasty's survival by itself; its weight became fully visible in the eleven years that followed. For the first time the Mongols campaigned on the Chinese frontier with a regular army and a sustainable supply system, and they learned the Jin's methods of fortification, the structure of its gates, the rhythm of its supply lines and the timing of its relieving armies; from then on the war against Jin was no longer a raid across the border but a planned long-term conquest, and it ran along exactly that road through the defeat at Yehuling in 1211, the fall of Zhongdu in 1214, the loss of Bianjing in 1215 and the destruction of the Jin at Caizhou in 1234. Muqali also carried Mongol government from the steppe into the Chinese plain during these years: he took over Han Chinese offices and taxes, re-enrolled the levied households into Mongol formations, and Han troops became the manpower the Mongols used most for sieges and for the campaigns against Song and Western Xia; the fortification techniques, the craftsmen and the agricultural system the Jin had built were absorbed by the Mongols and turned into Mongol siege power. The Jin, for its part, spent its northern provinces, its frontier garrisons and its agricultural colonies in one campaign after another, and the Xuanzong court could no longer fight the Mongols and Western Xia at the same time; after 1211 it gave up moving the capital east, and its policy ran from holding the border to holding Zhongdu and finally to holding Bianjing, with the treasury and the manpower of the realm exhausted within twelve years. The same campaign also brought a state secret weapon into the arms race of East Asia: Byzantine Greek fire was still being thrown from the bronze siphons on the walls of Constantinople in the siege of 1203, Latin assault towers were burned, and the Venetian attempt to reply with fire ships was consumed in the Golden Horn; in the same decade the Jin fire lance and thunder-crash bomb were tried out on the walls of northern China, and Mongol siege columns from that time on carried earth, wet felt and ditches against fire attacks.
result: 按蒙古方面的記載，合蘭真沙陀與折折運都山兩處的結果都是蒙古軍得手：金的邊騎被擊退，界壕沿線的巡邏與屯戍被壓制，蒙古軍取得了向漢地邊境推進的跳板，金廷被迫把西京路、河東與河北西路的守軍集中到北線；金方史籍則多作「邊軍敗績」一類的簡筆。但蒙古沒有拿下任何一座要津，也沒有打到中都城下；冬季一到，牧群無法隨軍，蒙古軍的補給立刻吃緊，而金的援軍與屯田糧食不斷從南面補上，攻勢在1204年春天收住。真正的勝負並未在這兩處地名上決定，而是在往後：蒙古在1211年野狐嶺以迂迴包抄吃掉金軍主力，1214年攻陷中都，1215年迫使金廷遷都汴京，1234年在蔡州最後消滅金朝。金守住了合蘭真沙陀與折折運都山的防線，卻沒守住往後的每一道防線；蒙古在這兩場邊境戰裡學到的最重要的一件事，正是攻城難而野戰易，從此把主力放在流動戰與長期消耗上，直到拖雷於1232年借假道攻金，才真正打開中原的門檻。
resultEn: On the Mongol account the result at both Halan Zhensha Tuo and Zhezhe Yundushan was success: the Jin border cavalry was driven back, the patrols and agricultural colonies along the boundary ditch were pinned down, and the Mongols obtained the springboard from which to push on into the Chinese borderlands, while the Jin court was forced to concentrate the garrisons of Xijing Circuit, Hedong and western Hebei on the northern line; the Jin histories record the matter only in a few strokes as frontier defeats. But no important pass and no walled town fell, and the army never came under the walls of Zhongdu; when winter came the herds could no longer follow, the Mongol supply grew tight at once, and Jin reinforcements and stored grain kept arriving from the south, so the offensive was called off in the spring of 1204. The real decision was not made at these two places but later: the Mongols destroyed the main Jin army by outflanking at Yehuling in 1211, took Zhongdu in 1214, drove the court to Bianjing in 1215 and finally annihilated the Jin at Caizhou in 1234. The Jin held the line at Halan Zhensha Tuo and Zhezhe Yundushan and did not hold every line after that; the single most important thing the Mongols learned in these two frontier engagements was that towns were hard to take and open country was not, and from then on they put their strength into mobile warfare and long attrition, until Tolui's march through Song territory in 1232 finally opened the threshold of the central plain.
